messages:
alyssa: Night shift heads up — after the mTLS egress policy landed in az-3, a bunch of GPU nodes failed to finish onboarding. KMS decrypts returning TLS handshake errors, keystore connections timing out. Anyone oncall? :eyes:

mike: Seeing it too. Keystore-proxy logs show `tls: remote error: tls: bad certificate` right after policy applied. Pods can't reach privatelink endpoint. GPU warm pools stuck in JOINING state.

samir: Pasted the relevant log:```
2024-06-12T02:12:03Z keystore-proxy[2345]: accept handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2024-06-12T02:12:04Z gpu-agent[778]: onboarding: failed to decrypt node secret: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
```

nina: Audit shipper also lost connection to central ingest for az-3 around the same time — backlog started building. We are seeing both 4xx TLS errors and a handful of 5xx proxy timeouts. Storage spikes if backlog keeps backfilling.

ops-bot: ALERT: keystore-privatelink-egress-policy triggered in az-3 (policy/mTLS-tighten) — 89 endpoints failing — severity: high.

alyssa: Root cause hypothesis: the new egress policy started strict client cert verification on the privatelink target, but keystore clients present rotated certs (not yet propagated). So mutual TLS is rejecting them. That explains both KMS decrypt fails and audit shipper disconnects.

jen: Quick mitigations: 1) rollback the egress policy 2) add a temporary SG/NAT exception for keystore-subnet 3) allowlist SNI for keystore endpoints. Which do we want now?

mike: Rolled back policy in az-3 at 02:26 — confirmed via `kubectl get networkpolicy` change and `aws ec2 modify-security-group-rules` actions. GPU pool JOINING -> READY transitioned within ~6m for most nodes.

samir: Can confirm warmup resumed. We still have audit backlog (~120k messages) that will be backfilled; storage and request costs increase while backfill runs.

nina: Cost hit estimate from the backfill and extra on-demand warmups: ~6 hours of on-demand GPU time + S3/ingest egress, ballpark $2.1k. I'll attach more precise numbers in the ticket.

alyssa: Action items: - open infra ticket to coordinate cert rollout and mTLS deploy gating - add automated test in deploy pipeline that exercises keystore client cert rotation - create short-lived exception play (NAT or SG) for emergencies - update runbook with rollback steps and owner

jen: Runbook snippet for rollback (staging -> prod flow):```bash
# rollback networkpolicy
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-all-egress-temp
  namespace: infra
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
EOF
# aws sg change for keystore-subnet (example)
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-KEEPR --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.0.0/16
```

oncall-eng: acked. I'll create INC-2024-9876 and assign to infra-sre. I'll also open infra ticket INFRA-6543 for the cert rollout plan and link the runbook PR.

samir: Longer-term fix: add SNI-based allowlist and add e2e test in the mTLS deploy pipeline that runs a keystore decrypt against a staging privatelink. Also add healthcheck alert that distinguishes TLS handshake errors vs connectivity timeouts.

nina: +1 to tests. Also recommend we add a short cooldown window to the rollout CI (e.g., 30m canary) and metric checks: keystore success rate, GPU join rate, audit ingest ack latency.

alyssa: I'm putting together a quick postmortem note for the shift handoff. Will include timeline, cost delta, and proposed gating steps.

ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2024-9876 — mTLS egress policy caused keystore handshake failures in az-3; rollback initiated, warmup resumed.

jen: assigning owners: infra-sre (samir), platform-security (alyssa), devexp (nina). I'll open the PR for the runbook update and tag the groups.

oncall-eng: Follow-ups: PR to add canary test, alert runbook update, billing estimate in INFRA-6543. I'll bump the priority to P1 for the rollout gating work.

alyssa: Thanks all — we should be good for now, keeping the policy paused until cert rotation is validated in staging. Posting final notes to #incidents later today. :white_check_mark:
